title: Plenty of Space, Private Entrance
description:
This is a full basement w/private entrance and private space. We live on the top two floors.  A quiet neighborhood on a dead-end street. Queen size bed in bedroom, sofa bed queen and a futon with a double on the bottom and a twin on the top. There is no kitchen but access to a full size refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, and utensils.

The space
Main bedroom has a door for privacy.  Bathroom is outside the main bedroom and has a three steps entrance. The other two areas have a curtain to separate sleeping areas.  Games and puzzles for your pleasure.

Guest access
Full basement and access from the outside without going into our portion of the house.

Other things to note
Nashville locations and how far they are from us:  
Belmont University (12 miles North);  Vanderbilt university (13 miles North); Bridgestone Arena (12 miles North);  Airport (15 miles East);  Grand Ole Opry/Gaylord Opryland (13 miles North);  Franklin (14 miles South);  Brentwood (4 miles West);  Nashville Zoo (5 miles North)
